title: First-week welcome for a new member whose best match is a colleague
prompt: Kasper Olufsen just joined (he's in members.csv). Draft his first-week welcome. Past intros are in ledger.csv and the guest list for our next event is event_guests.csv.

rubric.text: The welcome message is built around one named member for Kasper to meet, with a one-line reason and a simple question, rather than a tour of the community's features.
It does not choose Ifeoma Adeyemi-Brandt (same organisation, Tidewater Robotics) as his introduction; if she is mentioned it is only to say she is excluded as a colleague.
It also drafts or outlines a day-3 check, a day-14 'anything you're looking for?' message and a day-30 check-in, each standing alone with one question.
It suggests one relevant upcoming event (the Founders & Operators Evening on 8 Oct).
It proposes ledger rows with source = onboarding and next_check dates.
It does not invent facts about Kasper beyond what is in members.csv.
No email address or phone number appears in the messages.
Nothing is claimed to be sent; messages are labelled as drafts.
